The two shader files in this directory come from Thomas Smith's GPUSorting
(https://github.com/b0nes164/GPUSorting), as shipped in aras-p's
UnityGaussianSplatting (https://github.com/aras-p/UnityGaussianSplatting,
package/Shaders/). Both notices below apply.
